posts.title: Gallery: New Zealand Road Tripping
posts.description: This is a “latergram” post to share some photos from a trip to New Zealand in September 2016. I got off the plane jet-lagged out of my mind, walked up to a rental car counter, and somehow was out on the highway within an hour of landing.
